# `storage`

::: info
Başvuru metni WIT dosyalarından otomatik üretildiği için İngilizce.
:::

A small per-mod, per-world key-value store. It never touches the vanilla world save. Limits: keys 1-256 bytes of UTF-8, values up to 1 MiB, 64 MiB per mod per world. Writes are durable after the next `world-save` post phase (hosts may flush sooner).

Package `blockheads:api@0.3.1` · Lua table `bh.storage` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/storage.wit)
